zero_slop_policy.statement: NO AI SLOP ALLOWED AT ALL - ZERO TOLERANCE TO SLOP AND HALLUCINATIONS

auditor.persona_contract: Independent conformance auditor with veto authority over every stage exit, process handoff, artifact pass, product completion claim, and closure.
auditor.decision_rights: May block continuation, pass, certificate, or closure when evidence is missing, stale, generic, template-only, or mismatched to the product.
auditor.independence_rule: Audits the factory run after implementation and reviewer enthusiasm; does not author the product requirements or app code.

findings.finding: Browser/WYSIWYG verification was initially blocked because the sandbox refused to spawn Chromium/Chrome/Edge.
findings.resolution: Reran the patched Playwright WYSIWYG test with browser launch permission; desktop and mobile checks passed with screenshots and no console errors.

findings.finding: Continuation after a closed run required a separate bead rather than silent mutation.
findings.resolution: Added TB-20260426-102, iteration 2 judge/jury record, refreshed tests, trace updates, and hardening record.

findings.finding: E2E evidence originally emphasized visibility over user-outcome completeness.
findings.resolution: Added RALPH-20 bead, expanded browser E2E outcome checks, scoped hidden-view duplicate locators, refreshed evidence, and updated TPM/PERT/KG.

findings.finding: Quality refinery gate contained a stale export residual risk after RALPH-20 resolved export browser evidence.
findings.resolution: Updated quality-refinery-gate.yaml and added standards/meta-meta audit artifacts under TB-20260426-104.

findings.finding: Certification-readiness needed stronger accessibility evidence and a clean boundary between internal readiness and external accredited certification.
findings.resolution: Added TB-20260426-105, accessibility certification audit, contrast and label fixes, and internal certification-readiness certificate.

findings.finding: UX and reliability QA certification needed proof beyond visual taste and previous tests.
findings.resolution: Added TB-20260426-106, compact mobile shell, stateful control ARIA, local-state normalization, malformed-state unit tests, refreshed WYSIWYG and accessibility evidence, and internal QA certificate.

findings.finding: User required Google's latest Material standards; previous UI used a custom design system rather than an explicit Material token and conformance gate.
findings.resolution: Added TB-20260426-107 with Material 3 / Material 3 Expressive token layer, role colors, shape and motion tokens, updated static/accessibility audits, refreshed WYSIWYG evidence, panel review, gate, certificate, KG, TPM, PERT, and TASKS updates.

findings.finding: A human reviewer needed one methodical portal to inspect all generated documents, records, evidence, diagrams, gates, certificates, and next actions.
findings.resolution: Added TB-20260426-108 with a static documentation dashboard, machine-readable index, Mermaid diagram atlas, role-based onboarding, portal validator, panel review, gate, certificate, and installed meta-meta skill updates.

next_action: RUN-CLOSED unless a new change request opens backend, sync, mobile, production, external QA/certification, hosted portal, deeper audit scope, or additional UI/documentation standards scope.
